mechanism: Naloxone's opioid antagonism may precipitate withdrawal symptoms in patients taking lisdexamfetamine concomitantly if there is underlying opioid dependence, and both drugs have sympathomimetic effects that could be antagonistic or additive depending on clinical context.
action: Assess for opioid co-use before administering naloxone; monitor cardiovascular status and CNS effects when both agents are present; consider timing and clinical indication for naloxone administration.
